summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on June 18, 2026, containing two announcements to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange regarding adjustments to the conversion rates of its convertible senior notes due 2031 and 2032. The adjustments result from the declaration of a US$0.13125 per ordinary share (US$1.05 per ADS) annual regular cash dividend for fiscal year 2026. Per the notes' terms, the conversion rate for the 2024 Notes (due 2031) was adjusted from 9.8915 to 9.9823 ADSs per US$1,000 principal amount, with the maximum conversion rate similarly adjusted. This filing represents routine administrative actions tied to dividend declarations and is not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change elements; the filing is a standard reporting requirement for a foreign private issuer.
